title: A Hadoop YARN ResourceManager is reachable
summary: The YARN ResourceManager API answers unauthenticated.  It can be made to run a job, a known path to code execution on the cluster.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("hadoopVersion") and body_contains("clusterInfo") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Enable authentication on YARN and keep it off the public internet.
